text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yo! Thanks for yesterday.
Sailing on my mate's ship was a great way to blow off some steam!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: The captain is me, of course!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Take the helm... make merry and sing with your crew!
And talk about your dreams until the sun goes down!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, just remembering it makes me grin!
I'm so glad I worked my butt off
to get that small boat license!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you join me next time?
I'm sure it will be a truly irreplaceable experience.
